NHL EDGE leaderboards

Source: R/edge.R
nhl_edge_leaders.Rd

The NHL's EDGE top 10s: fastest skaters, most distance skated, hardest shots, most offensive-zone time, and the clubs' skating speed. landing gives the leaders the EDGE home pages show for skaters, goalies or teams.

Usage

nhl_edge_leaders(
  metric = c("skater_speed", "skater_distance", "skater_shot_speed", "skater_zone_time",
    "team_skating_speed"),
  position = c("all", "F", "D"),
  strength = c("all", "es", "pp", "pk"),
  sort_by = NULL,
  season = NULL,
  game_type = "regular"
)

nhl_edge_landing(
  type = c("skater", "goalie", "team"),
  season = NULL,
  game_type = "regular"
)

Arguments

metric

Which leaderboard.

position

"all", "F" (forwards) or "D" (defence).

strength

For distance and zone time: "all", "es" (even strength), "pp" or "pk".

sort_by

The ranking: for speed and shot speed "max" (top speed) or a burst band ("over22", "20-22", "18-20" for skating speed; "over100", "90-100", "80-90", "70-80" for shot speed); for distance "total" or "max-game"; for zone time "offensive", "neutral" or "defensive". NULL picks the first.

season

Season (see nhl_season()); NULL for the current one.

game_type

"regular" or "playoffs".

type

"skater", "goalie" or "team".

Value

A tibble, one row per player or club.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
nhl_edge_leaders("skater_speed")
nhl_edge_leaders("skater_shot_speed", position = "D")
nhl_edge_landing("goalie")
}
